bibliographic.title: Where we'll live for nine days
bibliographic.author: Pseudavid
bibliographic.description:
A small flat. Uncertain light. Two frightened people locked in for nine days. Eroding sense of reality.

An ambiguous story where feelings, memories and words themselves are unreliable.

Where we'll live for nine days is a short horror interactive story made of fragmented memories to be pieced together. Choices don't change the story, only the way it is told.

Playthrough length: approximately 10 minutes.

Fullscreen recommended. Playable in mobile.

Written for Ectocomp 2017.
